categories.main_business_segments: Toho Gas operates four main business segments: Gas (manufacture and sale of city gas and gas appliances), LPG & Other Energy (LPG sales, LNG sales, heat supply, and related equipment), Electricity (electricity sales), and Other (LNG processing, real estate management, engineering, IT services, leasing, and overseas energy investments). The Gas segment is the core, with significant contributions from LPG, electricity, and diversified services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include city gas production from imported LNG, advanced pipeline network management, and safety systems. The company is actively developing carbon-neutral technologies such as CO2 separation and methanation, hydrogen combustion, and virtual power plants using batteries. Digital transformation (DX), AI-driven optimization, and non-invasive pipeline construction methods are also emphasized.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are residential households, commercial and industrial users, and public sector clients in the Tokai region (Aichi, Mie, Gifu), with additional LPG and electricity customers. The company also serves overseas markets through investments and partnerships, and provides engineering and real estate services to a broad range of clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in central Japan (Aichi, Mie, Gifu), with additional activities in Okayama and overseas investments in Australia, Canada, the US, and Europe. Over 90% of revenue and assets are Japan-based, but overseas business is a growing strategic focus.
categories.supply_chain_position: Toho Gas is positioned midstream and downstream in the energy supply chain, handling LNG import, city gas production, distribution, and retail sales. It also participates in upstream and midstream activities through overseas investments and LNG procurement, and provides downstream services such as appliance sales and engineering.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the shift from core gas/LPG to electricity and overseas businesses, promoting carbon neutrality (e.g., e-methane, hydrogen, CCUS), and expanding regional value-added services. R&D focuses on decarbonization, digital technologies, safety, and new business models, with KPIs set for carbon-neutral gas, renewable energy, and regional business profit.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of city gas, LPG, and electricity to end users, with supplementary income from equipment sales, engineering, real estate leasing, and information services. The company also earns revenue from LNG processing, overseas investments, and leasing operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other regional gas utilities (Tokyo Gas, Osaka Gas, Saibu Gas), electricity providers, and new entrants in the liberalized energy market. Toho Gas is a leading regional energy supplier in central Japan, with a strong local customer base and a growing presence in electricity and overseas energy projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated revenue was ¥656.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥30.9 billion and net profit of ¥25.5 billion. The company serves over 3 million customers, employs 6,074 people, and maintains a stable financial base with a 59.1% equity ratio. Growth is moderate, with a strategic aim to expand electricity and overseas business to match core gas/LPG scale by the mid-2030s.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Toho Gas emphasizes safe, reliable, and environmentally friendly energy supply, regional resilience, and customer-centric solutions. Its differentiation lies in advanced safety and supply systems, commitment to carbon neutrality, integrated energy services (gas, electricity, LPG), and strong local partnerships. The company positions itself as a trusted regional partner and a leader in sustainable energy transition.
